    • getNearestReachableComponents

      public ClientComponent[] getNearestReachableComponents(ClientComponent clientComponent) throws NullComponentException
      Returns the direct neighbours of the given component in the following order:
      • Index 0 - Top
      • Index 1 - Right
      • Index 2 - Bottom
      • Index 3 - Left

      NOTE: The direct neighbours are NOT diagonal, thus only the top, right, bottom and left adjacent components are considered as neighbours of the given component.
      NOTE: All returned neighbours (if any exist) are also REACHABLE from the given component, meaning that the connectors that bridge the gap between the latter and each neighbour are checked for validity. An invalid pair of connectors between two components implies that from the given component that particular neighbour cannot be reached, therefore the latter is not reachable from the former.
      Parameters:
      clientComponent - The component of which we want to get its direct neighbours
      Returns:
      A Component[] array of size 4 with the given component's neighbours
      Throws:
      NullComponentException - If the given component is null
      NullPointerException - If the position of the given component fails to yield legal coordinates

    • traverse

      public void traverse(Consumer<ClientComponent> lambda)
      Uses an adapted version of the BFS algorithm to iterate over each component of the ship's grid and also applies the given lambda function to each component that it encounters
      Parameters:
      lambda - The lambda function to apply to each component encountered. It must be of type Consumer of ClientComponent in order to return void

    • addComponent

      public void addComponent(ClientComponent clientComponent, int i, int j) throws NullComponentException, OutOfGridException, ExistingComponentException, OutOfShipException
      Adds the given client component at the given coordinates (i, j) in the ship's component grid.
      Parameters:
      clientComponent - The client component to add to the ship's grid
      i - The index of the row
      j - The index of the column
      Throws:
      NullComponentException - If the given client component is null
      OutOfGridException - If the given coordinates (i, j) fall outside the ship's grid
      ExistingComponentException - If the component at coordinates (i, j) is already occupied
      OutOfShipException - If the given coordinates (i, j) fall outside the ship profile, determined by the current difficulty level
